ValidationRule.description: This validation rule ensure that the format of the VAT Number is correctly captured by User, and follow the hungarian format. This rule can be bypassed by a User by checking the field 'BypassVR' on its account.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ER_Business_Unit__c = 'HU', NOT( OR( LEN( ER_VAT_Number__c ) = 0, REGEX(ER_VAT_Number__c , "[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{1}-[0-9]{2}") )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The format of the VAT Number must match Hungarian format : 11 digits xxxxxxxx-x-xx
